names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 16 martie.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 16 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Ρωμανός ο ἐν τῷ Παρίῳ», with the rank words left off. The page's epithet «ο ἐν τῷ Παρίῳ», in Parion, is left out of the stored form and kept in the life.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 16 martie — «Sfântul Mucenic Roman»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Ρωμανός ο ἐν τῷ Παρίῳ»

attestations.note: The page gives him an epithet the Romanian line does not, «ο ἐν τῷ Παρίῳ», in Parion, and one sentence, «Ο Άγιος Ρωμανός μαρτύρησε δια ξίφους» — he was martyred by the sword. It adds two lines of verse, gives no year and prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
